BACKGROUND
The City of Palmdale, a chartered city, has full authority to conduct business and
governance municipal affairs to best benefit the City of Palmdale and its residents.
Sections 100, 101, 102, and 302 of the City Charter, as supported by Palmdale
Municipal Code Section 3.08.140, including but not limited to section 3.08.140(A) and
California Government Code Sections 4529.10 and 53060 expressly empower the City
Council to hire professional and special services, as determined exclusively by the City
executives, including the Director of Finance as incorporated into the Director of
Operations, based on demonstrated skills, experience and abilities absent any
solicitation or request for proposals. Based on the experience the City has had and
currently has, the firm Tripepi, Smith & Associates, Inc. is capable and competent to
provide media, communication, and public outreach skills desired by and deemed
necessary for the delivery of municipal communications.

DISCUSSION
The City’s Communication Division has been significantly impacted by staff vacancies
and temporary leaves coupled with increased work requests for communications support
from other City departments. Staffing is needed to stabilize the number of work requests,
increase productivity, and provide timely deliverables of work products so issues are not
further exacerbated.

Tripepi, Smith & Associates possesses deep experience in over 100 California cities,
providing a full range of knowledge and capabilities the City seeks. This municipal
government familiarity is unique to Tripepi Smith due to the firm’s size and area of focus.
Their technical background as a website developer and expertise in the CivicPlus Content
Management System (CMS) makes the firm uniquely qualified to address the City’s
website needs, which the City has identified as a high-priority project.

Additionally, the firm has recently conducted work for Palmdale EPIC Energy and the
City’s Film Bureau Strategic Plan, making them familiar with the City of Palmdale. This
work has oriented Tripepi Smith to key City staff and demonstrated first-hand the firm’s
engagement experience and the quality of their work product.

FISCAL IMPACT
The cost for communication support services with Tripepi, Smith & Associates, Inc. for
one year is estimated not to exceed $40,000 per month of services provided for a total
estimated cost of $480,000. Funds will be made available in accounts 10117001-721960
upon agreement approval.

General Approach
Tripepi Smith sets small teams for client engagements. Although we are large enough to offer

and advertising, but also non-traditional marketing services around email campaigns, social
media, blogging, SEO, video production and more. This integrated approach to content
development makes the process more efficient and effective for clients.

We strive to breathe life into communications, and we work to strengthen client brands
because we know that consistent branding builds trust and helps audiences engage and
understand more. We believe in the power of design, and we believe that designing for the

We understand how to set complex projects, how to make PDFs accessible to assistive

making it look great.

Tripepi Smith believes in the power of data to inform good communications. Digital platform

goals of these summary reports are to create accountability for the team and to highlight the
work being delivered to City Staff leadership and, ultimately, the City Council if desired by the
City Manager.

The monthly metrics report not only includes summary data, but also benefits from an
insightful narrative provided by our team of communication experts.

The exact metrics we report are to be determined and will be scoped out in a kickoff meeting.
This service is normally priced on a fixed fee basis and Tripepi Smith will review the scope and
provide a fixed price to then seek authorization to deliver the report.

To view samples of our work, visit www.TripepiSmith.com/Work

Tripepi Smith’s creative professionals have worked with public and private clients on imagery,

Retainer Agreements
Many Tripepi Smith clients have a fixed baseline of work they need done every month, and

Fixed Price Agreements
Clients may desire a well-defined project to be accomplished by Tripepi Smith. Examples can
include a video or a website project or well-defined budget summary document. In these
cases, Tripepi Smith can provide a fixed price alternative to the client.

Billing
Time at Tripepi Smith is billed in 15-minute increments – i.e. we invoice our time in the
following examples: 1.25, .75, 4 or 6.5 hours.

If Tripepi Smith is requested to be onsite, we will invoice for travel time at half rate of the
resource’s Standard Rate. Travel costs will be reimbursed when agreed upon by the client.

Tripepi Smith will invoice for our time and materials work on the last day of the month for that
month’s work. Invoice terms are net 30 days. If fixed price work is requested and authorized,
the milestone payments will be determined via email authorization from the City.

THE CITY COUNCIL RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

SECTION 1.  Code of Conduct; Core Principles.

The City Council finds and declares that the following pertains to City of Palmdale Public
Officials. The term “Public Officials” will be used when referring to all who serve on the
city council, city commissions, boards, or committees (appointed or elected). The term
“the body” applies to any of those groups while sitting as decision bodies (council,
commission, committee, or board). When they sit in their respective decision bodies, they
will be referred to in terms of City Council, or as commission, or as committee, or as board
as applicable. The same is valid for the presiding officer, using either the Mayor or
chairperson as appropriate when referring to the presiding officer of the individual bodies.

Public Officials will abide by the following Core Principles:

  A. Public Officials should comply with both the letter and spirit of the laws and policies
  affecting the operations of government;

  B. Public Officials will use, as a basis for the management of meetings, Rosenberg’s
  Rules of Order in their most current published form;

  C. Serving in public office is a privilege and should be exercised in trust for the public
  good, not for personal or political gain for the City of Palmdale; and,

  D. Public deliberations and processes must be conducted openly, unless legally
  confidential, in an atmosphere of respect and civility that respects all points of view
  of all in attendance and in the best interest of all residents, businesses, and visitors
  to Palmdale.

SECTION 2.  General Policies.

Implementing the Core Principles is one of the guiding objectives in adopting this
Resolution. Accordingly, in addition to all requirements of applicable law, the Public
Officials must adhere to the following policies:

  A. Conduct of Public Official

  The professional and personal conduct of Public Officials must be above reproach

  other Public Officials, City employees, or the public and adhere to this Resolution
  at all times. The Rules of Order for decision-making bodies in the City of Palmdale
  are outlined in a separate resolution of the City Council.

  B. Respect for Process

  Public Officials in all decision bodies (Council, Commissions, Committees, and
  Boards) will perform their duties in accordance with the processes and rules of
  order established by the City Council’s governing Rules of Order and Code of
  Conduct. They will stay within the bounds of these guiding resolutions with their
  interactions and interactions with City staff and the public attending public
  meetings. All public meetings will include deliberation of public policy issues,
  meaningful involvement, implementation of policy decisions along with well-
  controlled interactions with the public.

  C. Conduct of Public Meetings

  Public Officials will fully prepare themselves for public issues and listen courteously
  and attentively to all public discussions before the body, focusing on the business
  at hand. They will adhere to the meeting rules of order (see Council Policy
  Resolution No. CC 2023-081, Rules of Order) as managed by the Presiding
  Officer. For proper order, the Presiding Officer will provide an opportunity for
  members to address items and ask questions by general and consistent rotation.
  Members shall refrain from interrupting others who hold the floor, avoid speaking
  out of turn, or demand more time than allowed by the Presiding Officer. Personal
  comments not germane to the business of the body must be explained as relevant
  to the business at hand and may be allowed or disallowed by the Presiding Officer.

  D. Communication (Exparte/Private)

  At the appropriate time provided, Public Officials will publicly share substantive or
  new information relevant to a matter under consideration or which may become
  under consideration by the body, which they may have received from sources
  outside the public decision-making process.

  E. Confidential Information

  Public Officials must respect the confidentiality of information concerning City
  property, personnel, or proceedings of the City. Public Officials will neither disclose
  confidential information, actions, or discussions of authorized closed sessions
  without proper legal authorization.

  provide the floor for a prescribed timeframe and may allow or deny the request
  to continue for consideration by the body.
